RESET_TEXT.en: Are you sure you want to reset your progress?
RESET_TEXT.zh: 你确定要*重置游戏*进度吗？

RESET_HOLD_TEXT.en: Hold ’Yes’ button for 3 seconds to reset.
RESET_HOLD_TEXT.zh: 按住“是”按钮 3 秒即可重置。

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_1.en: Slide your finger to cut the rope
TUTORIAL_LVL_1_1.zh: 滑动你的手指 *即可剪断绳索

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_20.en: Collect as many stars as you can

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_24.en: Sometimes, you need to move fast
TUTORIAL_LVL_1_24.zh: 有些时候，*你必须身手敏捷

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_5_1.en: Bubbles will lift up the candy

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_5_2.en: Pop the bubble with your finger

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_6.en: Don’t let the candy leave the box

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_8.en: You can restart the level by pressing this button
TUTORIAL_LVL_1_8.zh: 按下这个按钮 *就可以重新开始这一关

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_10.en: Automatic ropes appear when candy moves into range
TUTORIAL_LVL_1_10.zh: 自动绳会在糖果进入 *相应区域时出现

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_12.zh: 拉紧的绳索 *会变成红色

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_16.en: Keep candy away from the spikes

TUTORIAL_LVL_1_21.en: You can cut several ropes at once
TUTORIAL_LVL_1_21.zh: 你可以一次 *剪断几条绳索

TUTORIAL_LVL_2_1.en: Tap the air cushion to blow objects away

TUTORIAL_LVL_2_9.en: Cut the rope before the spider reaches the candy
TUTORIAL_LVL_2_9.zh: 在蜘蛛到达糖果之前 *剪断绳索

TUTORIAL_LVL_2_17.en: For some stars, you need to act fast to collect them
TUTORIAL_LVL_2_17.zh: 需要手疾眼快 *才能收集到某些星星

TUTORIAL_LVL_3_1.en: Some rope hooks can be moved with your finger
TUTORIAL_LVL_3_1.zh: 可用你的手指 *移动一些绳钩

TUTORIAL_LVL_4_1.en: Drop candy into one magic hat and it’ll fly out from the other
TUTORIAL_LVL_4_1.zh: 将糖果丢入魔术帽。*它会从另一个魔术帽中掉出

TUTORIAL_LVL_4_3.en: Candy maintains its speed when teleporting
TUTORIAL_LVL_4_3.zh: 糖果在传送时会 *保持其速度

TUTORIAL_LVL_5_1.en: Combine two pieces of candy before feeding Om Nom
TUTORIAL_LVL_5_1.zh: 在喂给 Om Nom 吃之前，*将两块糖合二为一

TUTORIAL_LVL_6_1.en: Candy will bounce away from this platform
TUTORIAL_LVL_6_1.zh: 糖果将从此平台 *蹦出来

TUTORIAL_LVL_7_1.en: Rotate the wheel to control the rope’s length
TUTORIAL_LVL_7_1.zh: 旋转车轮以*控制绳索长度

TUTORIAL_LVL_9_1.en: Toggle the blades with this button

TUTORIAL_LVL_9_2.zh: 这些叶片可以 *一起旋转

TUTORIAL_LVL_10_1.en: The bee carries candy along this path.
TUTORIAL_LVL_10_1.zh: 蜜蜂沿这条路径 *搬动糖果

TUTORIAL_LVL_11_1.en: Rotate the record using this handle.

TUTORIAL_LVL_11_6.en: Move the rope holder from one record to another.
TUTORIAL_LVL_11_6.zh: 将此绳柄 *从一个唱片移至另一个

TUTORIAL_LVL_12_1.en: The ghost has several forms. Tap to switch between them.
TUTORIAL_LVL_12_1.zh: 幽灵有多种形态。 *触按可以切换形态。

TUTORIAL_LVL_13_1.en: Tap the valve to switch between the 3 pressure modes.
TUTORIAL_LVL_13_1.zh: 轻触阀门可以转换 *3种压力模式。

TUTORIAL_LVL_14_1.en: Put candy in one lantern and it pops into all the others.
TUTORIAL_LVL_14_1.zh: 把糖果放入其中一个灯笼，*其他灯笼都会蹦进去

TUTORIAL_LVL_14_2.en: Tap any lantern to get the candy to drop down from it.
TUTORIAL_LVL_14_2.zh: 轻触任一灯笼，*丢出糖果

TUTORIAL_LVL_15_1.en: The mouse takes candy and moves it to different holes.
TUTORIAL_LVL_15_1.zh: 老鼠 *正在 *抓 *糖果，  *并 *把 *糖果 *转移 *到 *不同 *的 *洞穴*里

TUTORIAL_LVL_15_2.en: Tap the mouse to drop the candy.
TUTORIAL_LVL_15_2.zh: 点击老鼠图标 *丢下糖果

TUTORIAL_LVL_16_1.en: Light up Om Nom to wake him up
TUTORIAL_LVL_16_1.zh: 照亮 Om Nom *让他醒来

TUTORIAL_LVL_16_2.en: Light up the stars to activate them

TUTORIAL_LVL_17_1.en: Drag the belt to move objects with it
TUTORIAL_LVL_17_1.zh: 拖动传送带，*移动它上面的物体

TUTORIAL_LVL_17_8.en: You can shift objects from one belt to another
TUTORIAL_LVL_17_8.zh: 您可以将物体 *从一条传送带 *转移到另一条。

CANT_UNLOCK_TEXT3.en: Get more stars from the earlier levels
CANT_UNLOCK_TEXT3.zh: 从先前的 *关卡中 *获取更多*星星
